summary: Frontend-only retest of the two follow-up fixes (raw.githack -> cdn.jsdelivr.net conversion + removal of dead URLs). Flow used: /?cloaked=true -> 22s SW/WISP init -> 'Continue to browser' -> 'G4m3s' tile -> pages/g.html -> #searchInput -> .shortcut[data-name] -> '#iframeContainer iframe', then traversed page.frames() to the '/scramjet/' frame and evaluated {document.contentType, document.scripts.length, canvas count, title, body text}. RESULTS - ALL PASS: (1) Ex-githack games now play in ONE click, no 'External Content Notice / One more step' interstitial: 2048 (text/html, 11 scripts, board+'Join the numbers' rendered), Chrome Dino (text/html, 3 scripts, 1 canvas, 'Press Space to start'), Hextris (text/html, 29 scripts, 1 canvas), Hollow Knight (text/html, 2 scripts, 1 canvas, Unity WebGL loader progressing 44MB/860MB). (2) jsdelivr spot-check regression of the sw.js rawHeaders content-type fix: Angry Birds (text/html, 18 scripts, canvas), Baldi's Basics (text/html, 21 scripts, canvas, title "Baldi's Basics"), A Dance of Fire & Ice (text/html, 18 scripts, canvas). All iframe srcs contain /scramjet/. (3) archive.org regression: Prince of Persia proxied via /scramjet/, text/html, 10 scripts, canvas, and the intro cutscene was VISIBLY running in the screenshot. (4) Dead-game check: searching 'Five Nights at Freddy', 'Retro Bowl', 'Slither', 'Pizza Tower', 'Minecraft 1.12', '2048 Merge Run' returns 0 tiles each - removed as expected. Additionally I wrote /app/tests/check_game_urls.py which GETs all 268 catalog URLs: 268/268 return HTTP 200 and ZERO return jsdelivr's "Couldn't find the requested file" body -> no tile can open a dead text page. Catalog composition confirmed: 268 games = 197 cdn.jsdelivr.net + 70 archive.org + 1 docs.google.com, no raw.githack.com. (5) docs.google.com '[!] REQUEST GAME' still loads DIRECT (src has no /scramjet/) and the 'request game...' form renders with the Submit button. #closeBtn returns to the grid (#iframeOverlay display:none) after every game, and #searchInput filters correctly ('2048' -> exactly ['2048']).

issues: Loading spinner stays rendered ON TOP of the already-running game (visible over the Prince of Persia intro screen) - the loader is only hidden on iframe onload, which for archive.org/Unity titles fires before/after the visual start; hide it on first paint or after a short delay, and/or give it pointer-events:none.

Still no error/fallback state in the overlay: if a URL ever dies again or an upstream shows an interstitial, the user just sees foreign text with no retry / open-in-new-tab affordance (no problem reproducible today since all 268 URLs are live).

Game tiles and overlay controls still have NO data-testid attributes; tests must rely on .shortcut[data-name], #closeBtn, #searchInput. Please add data-testid to tiles, #closeBtn, #searchInput and the game iframe.
Minor: non-blocking console error on load - CORS/ERR_FAILED for the counter.leelive2021.workers.dev analytics beacon (third-party, unproxied).

action_items: No functional fixes required for this iteration's scope - all 6 requested checks pass.
Optional polish: hide/dim the overlay loading spinner once the game is interactive (it currently overlaps running games).
Optional: add data-testid attributes to game tiles, #searchInput, #closeBtn and the game iframe for stable automation.
Optional resilience: add an overlay error/fallback state + keep /app/tests/check_game_urls.py as a periodic link-rot guard (268/268 currently 200).
critical_code_review_comments: sw.js fixGameContentType() must keep mutating resp.rawHeaders in place (Scramjet builds outgoing headers from rawHeaders); do not refactor back to `new Response(...)` - that regresses every jsdelivr game to text/plain.
g.html: window.parent.flintProxyEncode is still unguarded - if Scramjet init hasn't finished, the tile would silently load the DIRECT (blockable) URL with no warning.
g.html: iframe.onload is still treated as unconditional success (no content-type / 404-body / interstitial sanity check).

success_rate.frontend: 100% - 8/8 games tested are proxied via /scramjet/ AND render as text/html with scripts+canvas (2048, Chrome Dino, Hextris, Hollow Knight, Angry Birds, Baldi's Basics, A Dance of Fire & Ice, Prince of Persia); 5/5 removed titles absent; 268/268 catalog URLs HTTP 200 with no dead-file bodies; docs form direct; closeBtn + search OK.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Flow: https://<base>/?cloaked=true -> wait ~22s -> click 'Continue to browser' in the nt.html frame -> click text 'G4m3s' -> in the pages/g.html frame fill #searchInput then click .shortcut[data-name="<name>"] -> read '#iframeContainer iframe'.src -> traverse page.frames() for '/scramjet/' (NOTE: ad/recaptcha sub-frames are also /scramjet/, pick the one whose URL contains the encoded game host) -> evaluate document.contentType/scripts/canvas. Wait 13-14s after opening a game. Grid renders lazily (65 tiles initially, paginated) so ALWAYS filter via #searchInput before asserting a tile exists. Playable baselines: 2048, Chrome Dino, Hextris, Hollow Knight, Angry Birds, Baldi's Basics, A Dance of Fire & Ice, Prince of Persia. Re-run /app/tests/check_game_urls.py to detect new link rot.
rca_of_the_issue: Both prior blockers are resolved: (a) raw.githack.com's document-navigation interstitial is gone because all 18 URLs were repointed to cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh, where the sw.js rawHeaders content-type override converts the text/plain response to text/html so the iframe parses and boots the game; (b) the 70 jsdelivr 404 entries were pruned from games.json, and a full sweep of all 268 remaining URLs returns 200 with real content, so no tile renders the 'Couldn't find the requested file' text page.
